payload.text: CI: run 41591508539 at 92105af, the first with both fixes: macOS all green, bats included; ubuntu's Cargo tests fail 3 replay cases (sync-apply-plan, sync-link-all-names, sync-link-apply). Cause, found by dc: all three write Zsofia Varga's About/(Contacts).inetloc, which the manifest names with the o decomposed (pplr writes .inetloc names decomposed, as Foundation did), while git on macOS (core.precomposeunicode) stored the golden precomposed; APFS equates the two forms and ext4 does not, so the replay's fallback read failed with a bare ENOENT. Fix approved (dc, tests/cli.rs only): find stored goldens by matching each path component's decomposed form, and name the path in the harness's io errors; no refusal and no skip, since PPLR_CONTACTS_JSON needs no macOS service (AC-00.7). Linux proof: CI after hv's next push, or kovacs if hv allows. ubuntu's bats step has still not run, so a further layer may follow. When both runners are green, ST0001 AC-02.1 and ST0002 WP02's CI half can close.
